reason: Source: 'Whether I can step over barriers or not, whether I dare stoop to pick up or not, whether I am a trembling creature or whether I have the _right_'. 'power' is an invented object for 'pick up' (Garnett names none). The past 'could'/'dared' also clashes with the present 'am'/'have' that follow in the same series; the source uses present tense throughout.
